LOCALIZATION: service/c074-server-svc
MECHANISM: The service definition for c074-server-svc has a misconfigured selector. The selector field should match the label of the pods it intends to route traffic to, but in this case, the selector is set to "app:c074-server", which does not match the actual label of the pod "c074-server" which has the label "app:c074-server". This mismatch causes the client pod to be unable to resolve the service.
SCOPE: Compound multi-resource
EVIDENCE: 
- Observation 1 shows the correct service definition with the selector set to "app:c074-server".
- Observation 3 shows the pod "c074-server" has the label "app:c074-server".
- Observation 5 lists all other services and their selectors, confirming no other service uses the same selector as c074-server-svc.
